senses.gloss: m. (dialect. = עַז, cmp. b. h. equivalent עזניה) gaz, name of a bird of prey, supposed to be the falcon.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 3:1">Ḥull. III, 1</cite> <he>הגז</he> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="E00078"><he>הגס</he></cite>). Tosef. ib. III, 3 <cite ref="E00078"><he>הגס</he></cite>. [Alleged name of a species of bees, v. <cite ref="E00064"><he>הִגְזִין</he></cite> or <cite ref="H00145"><he>חִגְזִין</he></cite>.]
